Class Json

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.api.io.net.Json
public final class Json extends Object
A bounded, non-allocating JSON field reader recognized as compiler intrinsics by Juno. Reads directly out of a byte[] buffer (typically one filled by HttpClient) without ever building a parsed document — Juno has no heap, so there is no DOM to build.

path must be a compile-time string literal. Object fields use dot notation and arrays use zero-based bracket indexes, for example "data.sensor.temp", "users[0].name", or "[2]" for a root array. The empty path addresses the root value. Field names containing '.', '[', or ']' cannot currently be addressed, and escaped JSON member names are not decoded while matching paths.

The scanner validates the complete bounded document before returning a value. Call type(byte[], int, String) when a missing value, JSON null, a type mismatch, and a malformed or truncated document must be distinguished. Typed getters retain convenient zero-value failure results and never allocate or throw. bufferLength must be the number of JSON bytes in the buffer (for example, the value returned by HttpClient.get(String, int, String, byte[], int, byte[], int, int[])), not the buffer capacity.

getString(byte[], int, String, byte[], int) decodes JSON escapes, including UTF-16 \uXXXX surrogate pairs, to UTF-8 in out. It writes at most outLength bytes and never appends a NUL byte.

getString(byte[], int, String) instead returns a bounded runtime String holding the value's raw JSON text (quotes stripped for an actual JSON string, no escape decoding) — useful for a JSON number when its exact source text matters more than its value parsed through getDouble(byte[], int, String), which loses precision for values not exactly representable in binary floating point.

    Description
    static int
    arraySize(byte[] buffer, int bufferLength, String path)
    Returns the number of direct array elements, or -1 on failure or a type mismatch.
    static boolean
    getBool(byte[] buffer, int bufferLength, String path)
    Returns a boolean value, or false when the value is absent or not a boolean.
    static double
    getDouble(byte[] buffer, int bufferLength, String path)
    Returns a JSON number, including fractions and exponents, or 0.0 on failure.
    static int
    getInt(byte[] buffer, int bufferLength, String path)
    Returns a strictly integral 32-bit value, or 0 on failure or overflow.
    static long
    getLong(byte[] buffer, int bufferLength, String path)
    Returns a strictly integral 64-bit value, or 0 on failure or overflow.
    static String
    getString(byte[] buffer, int bufferLength, String path)
    Returns the raw JSON text of any scalar value at path (a JSON string's content with its surrounding quotes stripped, or a number/boolean/null literal exactly as written), or null when the path is missing, resolves to an object or array, or the raw text is too long for Juno's bounded runtime-string pool.
    static int
    getString(byte[] buffer, int bufferLength, String path, byte[] out, int outLength)
    Decodes a JSON string to UTF-8 and returns the number of bytes written.
    static int
    type(byte[] buffer, int bufferLength, String path)
    Returns one of the TYPE_* constants for the value at path.
